newsitem.title: USA: International Cutlery Dec sales up 73.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: International Cutlery Dec sales up 73.8 pct.

text.p: International Cutlery Ltd said on Tuesday that it reported December 1996 sales of $921,000, which reflects a 73.8 percent increase over December 1995 sales of $530,000.
For the eight months of May through December 1996, the company reported sales of $1,802,000, a 45.2 percent increase over the $1,241,000 for the same period in 1995.
International Cutlery said its strong performance was attributable to an aggressive growth policy followed by management since the company's Initial Public Offering in December 1995.
